objective: Prevent consequential/high-risk operations from bypassing exact Human authority, preserve ruin/safety precedence, bind W2 local closure to the exact repaired source, and hand external acceptance one internally consistent source/evidence subject. NOT green-test maximisation.

gates.name: Compiler / source / RepoContext / gate calibration
gates.strictness: canonical Compiler lint+activation+acceptance+compile PASS; duplication identifies no second control plane
gates.deterministic_oracle: the canonical prompt-contract compiler under 知識庫/實作相關DOC/HG-KSEOS/construction-acceptance-prompt-compiler/

gates.name: HumanGate risk/ruin trigger
gates.strictness: P3/P4/P5 by RISK TIER or PERMISSION CLASS independently require a valid exact token; operation name may only tighten; RUIN/UNKNOWN_RUIN hard veto before approval and not overridable by any token
negative_cases: route object understating a P3 request
gates.anti_overfit: an independent lattice over {tier} x {operation name} x {token present} - the decay path must be a classification lattice, not a name list

gates.name: canonical ApprovalToken basis / lineage / integrity
gates.strictness: exact request->decision->token lineage; approval_basis_hash recomputed; RFC 8785 JCS over payload minus signature; fixed domain frame; real Ed25519 over exactly the framed bytes with current key generation; audience mandatory on gated paths; fail closed when required currentness/basis is unavailable
positive_controls: correct Ed25519 signature over the exact framed JCS bytes PASSES
gates.llm_judge_policy: ADVISORY_ONLY - a deterministic source/runtime contradiction outranks any model judgement
gates.fail_closed: TEMP_CLOSED_RUNTIME if exact JCS/Ed25519 capability cannot be qualified

gates.name: product tests and regression
gates.strictness: focused first-failing tests -> smallest repair -> focused PASS -> adversarial -> full preserved W1/W2 regression; denominator must not shrink silently
gates.baseline: 735 (W1 113 + W2 622) from the prior accepted evidence
gates.hard_rule: more tests is NOT a substitute for the canonical counterexamples

gates.name: exact-subject source freeze
gates.strictness: exact 40-hex source SHA; clean/readback workspace; no acceptance-affecting untracked mutation; all downstream artifacts bind this SHA

gates.name: fresh canonical-oracle independent checker
gates.strictness: fresh-context, read-only, VERIFY_ONLY, checker != maker; PI06/RBWI is authority and repo tests are evidence; must explicitly attack TOK-INV-001..014, the risk matrix, ruin precedence, §15.5, §16.1 and the lineage; a deterministic canonical contradiction may NOT be downgraded because repo tests agree with each other
gates.fail_closed: checker FAIL/PARTIAL routes back to maker; checker never repairs

gates.name: canonical HGK normative closure
gates.strictness: typed HGK APIs only (no consumer SQL writes); final normative checkpoint canonically bound to the exact new source SHA via the schema's actual binding surface and proven by RECOMPUTATION; all governed WorkOrders terminal; all acceptances terminal PASS and evidence-bound; lifecycle points at that checkpoint; denominator queries the same scope and is NONZERO/non-vacuous
gates.deterministic_oracle: HG-KSEOS var/shared-spine/hg-kseos.db (canonical) + the project scope's own rows
gates.hard_rule: 0/0 is ALWAYS invalid for this closure

gates.name: LocalClosure and evidence regeneration
gates.strictness: regenerate, never hand-edit, from raw final state; all artifacts agree on PR/branch/source SHA/evidence root/checkpoint/checker/claim ceiling; descriptor SHA-256 and byte counts computed from COMMITTED bytes; empty-file SHA or 0-byte placeholder for a nonempty descriptor is a hard failure; secret-scan denominator semantically unambiguous
negative_cases: e3b0c442 empty-file SHA recorded for a non-empty descriptor

gates.name: publication and remote readback
gates.strictness: A-H PASS on ONE exact source subject; PR.head.sha == source_candidate_sha; separate sanitized evidence commit; source_candidate_sha != evidence_commit_sha; remote readback of exact bytes; NOT merged
negative_cases: published subject whose exact independent receipt is PARTIAL
gates.fail_closed: TEMP_CLOSED_GITHUB (preserve local closure; never manufacture a PR/SHA)

tt_cr_policy: Every non-blocking residual is registered as a TT with an activation condition. A TT may not be used to downgrade a deterministic canonical contradiction.
hitl_boundary: HITL only at true authority edges: equal-rank source conflict, credential/permission grant, repository visibility policy, mutation outside authorised roots, destructive scope expansion, live consequential effects, merge/release/production. Routine repair/test/typed-state/evidence work proceeds without repeated HITL.
runtime_capability_note: Ed25519 is provided by the present `cryptography` capability. RFC 8785 JCS is NOT available in the environment and is implemented exactly in src/security/humangate.py (jcs_dumps); it must be attacked as exact, not accepted as 'sorted JSON'. If exactness were unavailable, the mandated state is TEMP_CLOSED_RUNTIME - approximating is forbidden.
